summary: Fitness Champs Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency letter on May 26, 2026, for non-compliance with Listing Rule 5550(b)(1) due to stockholders' equity of $598,490 as of Dec 31, 2025, falling below the $2,500,000 minimum. The company believes it regained compliance via a May 2026 financing, subject to Nasdaq review. It has 45 days (until July 10, 2026) to confirm compliance or submit a plan for up to 180 days. This is a routine regulatory notification, not a special situation; Nasdaq listing deficiency notices are procedural and do not represent an event-driven corporate action.
